data.name: textboxHowToPlay.Text
data.value: Welcome to Brawlerz! Once you press play, you will be welcomed with an immersive prologue. After this prologue, you will be then sent to the pregame-screen, in which you can use the movement keys, "A" or "D" to walk towards the door. Defeat each level using your attacks to eventually reach Gertrude, the current holder of the "Crown Of Glory". Heavy attacks will do more damage, but are slower to execute. Light attacks will have a quicker execution but in return, does less damage. Defeat Gertrude to reclaim your title as the holder of the "Crown Of Glory"! Enjoy.
